# Airmatix

Airmatix is a family HVAC shop in Granada Hills, California.
Owner Oscar Arevalo installs, repairs, and services air conditioners, furnaces, heat pumps, mini-splits, ductwork, and whole-house fans.
California C-20 license 1038698, issued April 2018 and current.
Shop address: 17842 Minnehaha Street, Granada Hills, CA 91344.
Phone: (818) 554-2620.
Email: airmatix@ymail.com.
Hours: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.
Serves Granada Hills and the San Fernando Valley, including Encino, Northridge, Burbank, Sherman Oaks, and Woodland Hills.
English and Spanish.
Call for service. A message form forwards to the shop email.
